extra.text: The guild's promise fits in one sentence: keep the rows burning. Bring rope, mesh, and reinforced fiber for a full route.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Pack each separately. Repairs made in darkness must be found by touch.

decline.text: Then the guild will shorten tonight's route. Thank you for answering plainly.

in_progress.text: Four rope, four mesh, two reinforced bundles. The dark charges interest on omissions.

ready.text: Every piece is here. Hand me the kit before the first torch gutters.

extra.text: The lanes will remain roads tonight, and no Grue will mistake them for a hunting ground.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
